_comment: LiteLLM PyPI supply-chain compromise reported by Socket on 2026-10-21. Malicious litellm 1.107.0 (all seven wheels, uploaded 2026-10-21 between 11:39 and 11:40 UTC) ships cook.pth, cook.py, and sitecustomize.py under litellm-1.107.0.data/purelib/, which run at every Python interpreter start without importing litellm: a credential stealer (privcollect) targeting cloud, Kubernetes, SSH, Git, npm/PyPI, .env, browser, and AI-tool (Codex, Claude, Gemini, Cursor) credentials, plus a remote Python loader. The release was removed from PyPI: the version JSON and deps.dev both return 404. Corroborated by OSV MAL-2026-2144 (modified 2026-10-21T22:01:01Z) and GHSA-92x9-889m-jgmw (updated 2026-10-22T00:32:04Z), which list 1.107.0 as affected. Container images (ghcr.io/berriai/litellm and related tags) mentioned by Socket are out of scope for package-ecosystem matching.
